name: confidence
description: Access Confidence feature flags, experiments, and migration tools directly from Cursor.

skills.name: migrate-eppo
skills.description: Migrate feature flags from Eppo to Confidence SDK. Use when the user says /migrate-eppo, asks to migrate Eppo flags, or transform SDK code to Confidence.

skills.name: migrate-optimizely
skills.description: Migrate feature flags from Optimizely to Confidence SDK. Use when the user says /migrate-optimizely, asks to migrate Optimizely flags/rollouts/experiments, or transform Optimizely SDK code to Confidence.

skills.name: migrate-posthog
skills.description: Migrate feature flags from PostHog to Confidence SDK. Use when the user says /migrate-posthog, asks to migrate PostHog flags, or transform SDK code to Confidence.

skills.name: migrate-statsig
skills.description: Migrate feature flags from Statsig to Confidence SDK. Use when the user says /migrate-statsig, asks to migrate Statsig gates/configs/experiments, or transform SDK code to Confidence.

skills.name: onboard-confidence
skills.description: Create Confidence accounts and onboard users. Use when the user asks to create an account, invite users, onboard to Confidence, or check account status.

skills.name: onboard-confidence-dry-run
skills.description: Dry-run the Confidence onboarding flow to test UX without real API calls. Use when the user says "dry run", "test onboarding", "demo onboarding", or wants to preview the onboarding experience.

skills.name: setup-warehouse
skills.description: Set up a data warehouse for Confidence experimentation analytics. Use when the user asks to connect a warehouse, set up BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks/Redshift, or configure data connectors.

skills.name: setup-warehouse-bigquery
skills.description: Set up BigQuery as a data warehouse for Confidence. Use when the user chose BigQuery for warehouse setup.

skills.name: setup-warehouse-databricks
skills.description: Set up Databricks as a data warehouse for Confidence. Use when the user chose Databricks for warehouse setup.

skills.name: setup-warehouse-redshift
skills.description: Set up Redshift as a data warehouse for Confidence. Use when the user chose Redshift for warehouse setup.

skills.name: setup-warehouse-snowflake
skills.description: Set up Snowflake as a data warehouse for Confidence. Use when the user chose Snowflake for warehouse setup.
